parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, circular in shape with a handle on top.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, and prevents spillage.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and not fixed to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume of the pot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, only moved when repositioning or cleaning the pot.
